title: Influence of patient head position and facial scanner viewing angle on the accuracy of the true horizontal plane located using an app-based facial scanner
html: App-based facial scanners capable of automatically generating reference planes, including the true horizontal plane (THP), have been developed to integrate virtual patient representations and transfer them to the virtual articulator. However, the influence of the patient head position and the facial scanner viewing angle on the accuracy of the THP located using an app-based facial scanner remains unknown.
